newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to auction 10-year JGBs on Tuesday -- sources.
newsitem.headline: MOF to auction 10-year JGBs on Tuesday -- sources.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is expected to auction 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) next Tuesday, traders said on Friday.
They said the offered volume would likely be one trillion yen, unchanged from the March issue, and the coupon rate likely set at 2.3 or 2.4 percent.
In either case, the rate would be a record low.
When the MOF last auctioned 10-year JGBs on March 25, it offered one trillion yen worth of 2.5 percent 10-year bonds.
